static_collection_scope.semantics: AST-local import closure from H3/loader/sampler/media entry points. Conditional branches and other model classes imported by common dispatch modules are preserved. Dynamic H3/Qwen3VL/VAE selectors are explicitly seeded.
static_collection_scope.third_party_boundary: PyTorch/Transformers/Tokenizers and standard runtime packages are pinned in metadata; full framework source trees are external dependencies.

mechanism_facts.fact: Main DiT uses 50 blocks, 2 token-refiner blocks, hidden width 5376, 56 attention heads of dimension128, FFN width14336, video latent24, audio latent32 and text feature5120.

This pruned checkpoint replaces the standard time embedder with a [1025,8] precomputed AdaLN time-curve basis. Each block AdaLN linear maps8 features; the code interpolates the time grid and evaluates AdaLN in FP32.

The 200 main DiT linear weights are I8 with per-output-row FP32 scales. All200 comfy_quant configs set int8_tensorwise, convrot=true, group size256. ConvRot applies matching groupwise Hadamard rotations in the quantized linear pipeline. Other model parameters retain BF16/F16/F32 storage according to the header.

The actual text encoder exposes unnormalized final hidden states from50 Qwen3-VL language layers. Its visual encoder has27 blocks.350 language linear weights use packed NVFP4 storage, each config sets full_precision_matrix_mult=true; the loader dequantizes weights for compute-dtype GEMM.100 pre_quant_scale tensors provide channel scaling; the embedding matrix is INT8.

Native short0177 audit records4000 successful cuda.int8_linear calls,0 failed,0 Triton or eager calls. The first input is BF16[45552,5376], weight INT8[21504,5376] and scale FP32[21504,1]. The installed Triton row guard remains part of launch configuration; this run selected CUDA dispatch.

The attention hook uses the actual aten Flash Attention output and log-sum-exp. Reference-video token bins and target-query membership are computed by H3Study layout; schedule chooses native/full interval/weak routing on each physical Euler forward.

inference_chain.detail: Isolated service uses the actual shared CORE and dependency overlay. The task queue submits frozen graph and metadata; native backend contract is observed from the first full forward.
Loader detects MiniMax H3 keys, derives dimensions and AdaLN curve settings from tensor shapes, selects quant layouts from comfy_quant JSON and loads models with stored scales.
Reference video is decoded/resized, tokenized with the actual Qwen vocabulary/merges and H3 special token additions, and encoded into language/vision states plus VAE condition latents.
VAE metadata selects video encoder/ViT decoder and audio encoder/BigVGAN decoder. H3 packed video/audio latents include preserved reference conditions.
RandomNoise seed2026101701, explicit20-step sigma list, video shift12/audio3, BasicGuider and Euler invoke20 physical DiT forwards.

Token refinement, packed layout, partial 3-axis RoPE, QK normalization, MM self-attention, AdaLN and gated MLP run50 blocks per forward; H3Study routes reference contribution according to the frozen schedule.
Video/audio VAE decode, CreateVideo24fps and SaveVideo h264/CRF16 produce the task output. Task audits bind73 generatedframes,60 valid referenceframes and video SHA.
